node.title: PMA official-rate small-source degree sieve
node.statement: On an exact official rate-1/r row, a maximal source with M<=r-2 has petal size ell>=k+1, while every exact core defect has d<=k-1; hence its strict d>ell full-petal residual is empty. This removes M<=6 at rate 1/8 and M<=14 at rate 1/16. At rate 1/4 with M=4,t=3, the upper mu-basis branch is possible exactly when 2b>=ell+8; the complementary branch has at most 4k contributors per carried source. The surviving M=4,t=3 count is confined to rate 1/2 and the rate-quarter large-background upper branch.
